home.impactTitle: One tree planted for every order
home.impactText: We partner with grassroots reforestation groups across India. Your purchase funds a tree — and our recycled paper packaging means the only thing we send out is good clothes.
home.testimonial1Text: The leggings survived 20+ classes and still look new. Knowing they're made from ocean plastic makes them my favourite.
home.testimonial2Text: Softest organic tees I've ever worn, and they arrived in beautiful paper packaging. Ethics aside, the feel is unreal.
home.testimonial3Text: Finally a brand that cares. I love scanning the QR to trace where every piece came from. This is the future.
home.newsletterText: Drops, giveaways and a small seeding of good news. No spam, just seeds.
about.title: Weaving a kinder wardrobe.
about.text: Greenweave started in 2021 with one stubborn belief: your clothes shouldn't cost the Earth. Today we make small-batch essentials in Auroville, Tamil Nadu, from fibres grown and recycled with care.
about.promise1Text: GOTS-certified organic cotton, European flax hemp and bamboo viscose. No pesticides, no GMOs, no shortcuts.
about.promise2Text: Low-water dyeing and natural indigo save up to 40% water per garment, with zero toxic runoff.
about.promise3Text: Every recycled-polyester piece turns discarded bottles and ocean plastic into fabric you'll love wearing.
about.promise4Text: We cut in small batches and tag every garment so you can trace it back to the mill and the hands that made it.
about.promise5Text: Every single order funds a native tree planted with grassroots groups across India.
about.promise6Text: Fair-trade wages, safe studios, and long-term partnerships with our makers in Tamil Nadu.
about.impactEyebrow: the receipts, not just the vibes
about.impactText: We won't hide behind vague claims — here's exactly what our community achieved together last year.
